description: decrypt accepts a framed message whose frame sequence numbers are out of order
streamed encrypt encrypts a plaintext longer than the plaintext-length bound
decrypt accepts trailing bytes appended after a valid ALG_AES_256_GCM_HKDF_SHA512_COMMIT_KEY message
decrypt accepts trailing bytes appended after a valid ALG_AES_256_GCM_HKDF_SHA512_COMMIT_KEY_ECDSA_P384 message
CreateClient accepts a Raw-AES keyring in the reserved aws-kms key namespace
the default frame length is 262144 where every other implementation defaults to 4096 (a default-value difference, not a validation bug)
encrypt rejects an encryption context entry whose value is the empty string ("All keys and values in encryption context must be non-empty"), though the message format permits a zero-length value

encrypt accepts an encryption-context key beginning with the reserved aws-crypto- prefix (other than aws-crypto-public-key); encrypt.md requires the operation to fail for any key beginning with aws-crypto-

encrypt and decrypt reject an encryption-context value of 32767 bytes or longer ("All keys and values in encryption context must be shorter than 32767"), though the message format permits value lengths up to 65535
decrypt accepts a footer whose signature field is the valid ECDSA signature with garbage appended and the signature length inflated to match; lenient signature parsing ignores the trailing bytes

a message encrypted with a __proto__ encryption-context key omits that key from the serialized header while still binding it into the data-key wrap, so no other implementation can decrypt it; the same-language round trip succeeds and masks it
encrypt of a non-positive frame length is rejected as a GenericServerError instead of the modeled ESDKClientError

CreateClient rejects a Raw-AES keyring in the reserved 'aws-kms' key namespace as an ESDKClientError instead of the framework GenericServerError. The native Rust server and the C++ shim currently build the Raw-AES keyring through the Dafny MPL, which surfaces this config-validation failure as an ESDK error rather than a framework error.

CreateClient rejects a Raw-AES wrapping key whose length does not match the wrapping suite as an ESDKClientError instead of the framework GenericServerError. The native Rust server and the C++ shim currently build the Raw-AES keyring through the Dafny MPL, which surfaces this config-validation failure as an ESDK error rather than a framework error.
